rows.note: Für Einkommen ab 319'900 Franken beträgt die Steuer 10,50% des gesamten Einkommens.

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Solothurn; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Solothurn; other communes in Solothurn set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

rows.label: Profit tax rate
rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Solothurn (Stand Februar 2026), Juristische Personen: Steuerberechnung, § 97 StG

rows.label: Cantonal multiplier 2026 (profit tax)
rows.value: 100% (including a 10% equalisation tax for the parishes)
rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der juristischen Personen (XLSX, sheet JP 2026)

rows.label: Communal multiplier 2026: Solothurn (cantonal capital; other communes differ)
rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der juristischen Personen (XLSX, sheet JP 2026)

rows.label: Church tax on legal entities 2026: Solothurn
rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der juristischen Personen (XLSX, sheet JP 2026)

rows.label: Property tax (Liegenschaftssteuer)
rows.value: None: the canton and its municipalities levy no property tax
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026)

rows.label: Transfer tax rate
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: Solothurn Gesetz über die Staats- und Gemeindesteuern (Steuergesetz, BGS 614.11), Stand 1. Januar 2025, §§ 208 and 212

rows.label: Reduced rate
rows.value: Half the rate (1.1%) for acquisitions between spouses, registered partners and by descendants
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: Solothurn Gesetz über die Staats- und Gemeindesteuern (Steuergesetz, BGS 614.11), Stand 1. Januar 2025, §§ 208 and 212

rows.label: Who pays
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: Solothurn Gesetz über die Staats- und Gemeindesteuern (Steuergesetz, BGS 614.11), Stand 1. Januar 2025, §§ 208 and 212
